description: List delivery attempts for one webhook, to check whether events arrived. status is one of pending, delivered, failed (retried at next_attempt_at), or dead_letter (retries exhausted or the webhook was removed; these are not retried). Cursor-paginated: next_cursor is null on the last page. Webhook ids come from aidelly_list_webhooks. Read-only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_webhook_deliveries
title: List Webhook Deliveries
